effect_scale: L3 consumer input or state changed
_status_vocabulary._partial_note: PARTIAL added 2026-08-08 on the operator's review: an arc whose delivery is proven but whose final hop is mock-blind (a live model consumes it) may not vanish from the count by being reclassified a 'coincidental carrier' — that is the descriptive/non-control loophole wearing a new coat. PARTIAL arcs are counted and listed, never absorbed.
_status_vocabulary._owner_definition: owner = the mechanism that answers for the state's lifecycle and semantics: creation, mutation, invalidation, end of life (mandate items 5-6). ATTACHMENT — which object physically holds the field — is provable separately (a creation site, an instance lifetime) and does NOT by itself establish ownership; nor does absence of traffic DISPROVE it. Added 2026-08-08 after the operator overturned owner=NEGATIVE on the dead field: traffic absence proves the carrier dead, not the owner absent.

per_run.meaning: written somewhere in the perimeter during a run, so the value does not survive as constructed

read_only_in_perimeter.meaning: organs and configuration: the loop reads them, never reassigns

outside_only.meaning: mirror of replan_policy.max_total_replans; nothing in the perimeter reads it

dead.meaning: assigned at construction, never read or written by anyone, getattr included

by_origin.note: Origin classifies where the VALUE came from, not who owns it. `injected` means the constructor received it — the strongest argument that the loop is NOT its owner.

state_initialization.owner_note: Protocol item 6: initialization site, lifetime and type are provable; ownership is a separate claim and is not derived from `self.X = ...`.

path_ledger._arc_rule: FORMAL, second edition (operator's review 2026-08-08 caught a circularity in the first: if dependence had to be PROVEN for the arc to exist, an unproven nerve could hide behind 'no dependence established, so no arc yet'). EXISTENCE and STATUS are separate questions. A CANDIDATE ARC exists wherever a value actually crosses a phase or module boundary and enters a consumer — no proof of effect required; entering the queue is what makes the effect investigable. STATUS then grades the proof: UNPROVEN — dependence not yet shown; PARTIAL — part of the causal chain proven (e.g. delivery yes, effect mock-blind: the prompt_to_model family is PARTIAL by construction); PROVEN — dependence + semantics + protection shown; DEAD — absence of causal effect proven. An arc ends at the last consumer provable without a live model; hops into a live model form their own PARTIAL arcs. Granularity notes may group physical sites; they never delete a candidate. goal -> retrieval (C15) is the standing example: a candidate arc held as UNPROVEN precisely because its dependence is not yet shown.
path_ledger._mandate: Operator mandate 2026-08-08: dissect, prove and certify the whole CNS runtime control path. Clusters follow the REAL execution graph from runtime entry points, never file order. Statuses from path_statuses; UNPROVEN never becomes an assumption; a call edge is never a proven signal flow. A cluster is closed only when its report (SCOPE -> EXECUTION PATH -> SIGNALS/STATE -> OWNERSHIP -> FAILURE SEMANTICS -> TEST EVIDENCE -> MUTATION EVIDENCE -> VERDICT -> NEXT EDGE) exists and its critical contracts have proven bites. This ledger is the work queue and the proof journal, not the goal.
